pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Burning Arena.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: Obtain Burning Ashes from an Ignited Revenant and place one in the Altar of Fire at the Burning Arena. Prepare food, healing and room to circle before making the offering. Fire Resistance helps with fire; it does not cancel sword strikes or grabs.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: Fire Resistance helps with fire; it does not cancel sword strikes or grabs. Extra maximum health does not neutralize attacks with a target-health component. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Ignitium Ingot, Music Disc. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
